description: US EPA Renewable Fuel Standard RIN data from EPA's public RFS data app (EMTS): weekly volume-weighted average prices of separated D3, D4, D5 and D6 RINs (USD, by RIN year and QAP verification type), weekly RIN trade volumes, RINs generated per year by D code (gross, error corrections, net) and monthly RIN generation by producer type and fuel category with gallons. Filter by D code and year; EPA refreshes it monthly. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
